_doc: 3-man Gravewyrm Sanctum FARM. pala1/Pontius (paladin, the TANK + leader -- Protection: Righteous Fury aura + Consecration spam for threat, Seal of Righteousness/Judgement) + ryze3/ryzeheal (priest, the HEALER -- Renew + Lesser Heal, Power Word: Shield on the tank) + sham2/Shims (shaman ENHANCEMENT, the melee DPS -- Stormstrike + Earth Shock). NO warrior, NO mage (kept off the live realm to shrink the multi-account footprint). The paladin is auto-picked as tank (first melee in the bots list; shaman is now in the orchestrator MELEE set so it closes to melee for Stormstrike). They march to the Sanctum door (0,880), single-pull chamber-by-chamber to the three bosses looting every corpse, then after KORZUL dies + loot is grabbed they RESET the instance (leave + reform = fresh instance) and farm again. WARRIOR-less: the PALADIN (tank) need-rolls everything; the other two greed. Run via scripts/_farm_supervisor.sh (CFG points here), or: node scripts/multibox.mjs scripts/multibox.gravewyrm3.json
